solid_tile_root_cause.evidence: The wider viewport exposes grey solid-tile debug borders; pinned TileBasedLayerImpl selects this color only for SOLID_COLOR_MODE. Turning debug borders off restores every captured normal image byte-for-byte.
solid_tile_root_cause.finding: Pinned Chromium marks the affected white edge tiles SOLID_COLOR_MODE. Such tiles bypass ordinary raster playback, including its background-hint boundary clear. The previous whole-layer hint introduced six green columns in white edge tiles.
solid_tile_root_cause.no_pixel_inspection_in_renderer: The renderer derives tile colors analytically from owned paint operations; unknown operations retain ordinary picture raster.
